status: CPU reference/spec only. No installed runtime patch, no GPU launch.
attribution: Own rescaled-addition adaptation, not official SS rotation/layer selection.
paper_audit: Eq2 already preserves norm under orthonormal B; AppendixB.1 Eq18 incorrectly infers unequal norms from unequal vectors. Zero-angle identity fails but norm need not. Safety/tinyBenchmarks results do not establish reasoning compression. Official linked code exists, implementation not audited.
single_change: Rescale complete decoder output after original dynamic addition; retain raw vector, layer20, original fit/labels/controller, sampling and L27.

interface.flag: rebalance_preserve_complete_norm, default false; distinct from generic normalize
interface.runtime_requirement: Verify actual deployed source and hashes before isolated patch. Both local API and algorithm reject normalize=True; do not merely remove guards or modify generic graph family. No shared files changed.
interface.state: No temporal state; option copied on request registration and cleared on slot reuse. Padding/nonsteered rows unchanged. Old coefficient and boundary history lifecycle unchanged.
interface.complete_state: x=hidden+residual; alter hidden only, preserve residual. Never normalize MLP output alone. Reductions float32, output dtype rounding reported.
interface.fallback: Zero/nonfinite norm returns original hidden row; log counts, unexpected fallback fails engineering. Alpha0 exact identity. Disabled branch original arithmetic, no norm reductions.
interface.order: Only decoder injection changes, before downstream logits. Existing confidence/boundary/suppression/sampling order unchanged; future confidence can change consequentially.

rmsnorm_caveat: Scaling approximately cancels in next RMSNorm attention input (epsilon aside), but residual carried to later addition changes. Not globally a no-op or guaranteed protection.
